proof_in_the_paper: The XRD patterns (Fig. 1a and Fig. S4) exhibit the intermetallic characteristic of PtCu3 NPs. The two other obvious broad peaks at 42.9 and 49.6°, produced by the ultra-small PtCu3 NPs, are signed to (111) and (200) planes. The HRTEM image (Fig. 2c) and corresponding Fast Fourier transforms (FFT) patterns (Fig. 2d) of O-PtCu3/rGO-8NH4OH catalyst display superlattice reflections of (100) and (110), verifying the L12 ordered structure of PtCu3 NPs.
